transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because flying has gotten a lot scarier for me than it feels like it should be. Just thinking about getting on a plane brings back the turbulence on my honeymoon flight. I know people fly safely every day, but I still picture it happening again.
Aside from times when you're thinking about or planning a flight, do you ever have unwanted memories, flashbacks, or nightmares about that turbulent flight?
No, I haven't noticed that. It mostly comes up when I'm thinking about flying or making travel plans.
Do you ever experience sudden episodes of intense fear or panic—like your heart racing or feeling short of breath—that come out of nowhere, even when you're not thinking about or dealing with flying?
No, I don’t think so. It’s really tied to flying or the idea of having to fly.
